name: Dispensing of compressed natural gas, CNG; at pump
description: This process represents the transport of natural gas from refinery to end-user pump. Data for transportation and distribution of natural gas is sourced from R&D GREET 2024. Compression of the natural gas is not included in this process.

processDocumentation.timeDescription: Data are from GREET published in 2024, but specific data for transportation and distribution are based on BTS data from 2009.
processDocumentation.geographyDescription: Does not include Puerto Rico and the Virgin Islands.
processDocumentation.completenessDescription: All data referring to production-to-pump fuel transportation methods are included. Data on emissions from dispensing are excluded. The compression step is also missing from this dataset.
processDocumentation.dataSelectionDescription: Data are sourced from the "T_D_Flowcharts" tab of GREET for North American natural gas to refueling station for CNG production.
processDocumentation.samplingDescription: "Based on U.S. ton-miles of natural gas freight via pipeline in 2009 as reported by DOT’s Bureau of Transportation Statistics (BTS), special tabulation, Table 1-50, and tons of dry natural gas production in the same year as reported by Energy Information Agency (EIA)."

sources.name: Argonne National Laboratory (2013) Update to Transportation Parameters

processDocumentation.intendedApplication: This process is applicable for modelling the fuel input into mobile equipment.
processDocumentation.projectDescription: This process has been updated by the FLCAC Data Curator.
